text:
anya: heads up, onboarding run for reranker-v3 (int8 PTQ) shows puzzling shape: NDCG@10 up across the board but MRR@1 drops specifically on title-only and html-heavy docs. anyone else seen HTML/meta noise cause this?
diego: curious numbers?
anya: quick paste from eval-bot: 
```
GLOBAL (200k): NDCG@10 +1.9%
TITLE_ONLY (8k): MRR@1 -3.6%, NDCG@10 +0.4%
HTML_META (5k): MRR@1 -4.8%, NDCG@10 +0.7%
SAMPLE_PVAL: title p=0.002, html p=0.0008
TAIL_LATENCY: +9ms 95p
```
nina: p-values look solid. pattern suggests top-1 gets swapped out but list still ranks OK (hence NDCG up). could be a candidate truncation or leading-token shift.
diego: did the onboarding preproc change? we recently flipped doc-split joiner to preserve headings and collapse whitespace. that might introduce duplicated headings like "Overview" repeated, which could perturb the first-pass score.
anya: i used branch onb/rerank-2026 which enables the new joiner. repro command i ran: `./eval/run_cohort --model reranker-v3-int8 --cohort HTML_META --preproc onboard-joiner`
eval-bot: job 41288 queued on runner-5.
(anya later) anya: repro offline with prod preproc shows smaller drop (MRR -1.1%). difference between onboard-joiner and prod-joiner is noticeable.
nina: can you diff the tokenized windows? token shifts can change candidate-first token, which often tilts MRR. run `tools/token_window_diff --a prod --b onboard --sample 2k`
anya: ran that. summary: ~4% of docs have first-window token sequence differing by >2 tokens, mostly due to heading repeats and HTML tag collapse.
diego: next step: ablate heading-preserve mode (i.e., collapse repeated headings and dedupe identical sentence prefixes). also try hybrid quant (int8 FFN, fp16 attention) to see if int8 noise amplifies the swap.
anya: did a quick ablation: 
```
joiner-collapse: HTML_META MRR@1 -1.0%
joiner-allow-headings: HTML_META MRR@1 -4.8%
hybrid-quant + joiner-collapse: HTML_META MRR@1 -0.4%
```
anya: hybrid looks much better, and joiner-collapse helps a lot.
nina: sounds like two orthogonal effects: preprocessing causing token ordering shifts, and quant noise amplifying rank swaps. we should add a tokenizer-parity test in onboarding CI so preproc mismatches are caught early.
diego: agree. also add a small failure sample export for manual inspection (50 examples) to the bringup run. nina, can you propose a gating threshold for title/html slices?
nina: suggest requiring per-slice MRR@1 delta >= -1.5% for int8 PTQ, and < -1% for hybrid. fallback on failing slice to run hybrid and dedup-joiner automatically.
anya: i'll implement gating: pipeline/bringup/reranker-v3 -> add eval stage `slice_checks` with rules: `title_only.mrr_1 > baseline - 0.015` and `html_meta.mrr_1 > baseline - 0.015`. eval-bot created PR stub.
eval-bot: PR #2785 created: bringup: add slice_checks for reranker-v3.
diego: can we also run bootstrap significance with paired sampling to ensure these deltas are robust? small slices can be noisy. run `python eval/bootstrap_pairs.py --cohort TITLE_ONLY --iters 10k`
anya: queued bootstrap. quick pass: TITLE_ONLY 95% CI delta [-4.1%, -2.8%] vs baseline for original joiner; after collapse joiner CI [-1.6%, -0.7%].
nina: that's convincing. please add a docs note describing the joiner change and why dedupe is important for rerankers (link to eval notebook).
anya: will do. plan: 1) ship joiner-collapse to onboard preproc, 2) add tokenizer-parity test and bootstrap step to onboarding CI, 3) default to hybrid quant if HTML_META or TITLE_ONLY slices fail gate, 4) export failure samples to S3 for triage. I'll target a hotfix today and full sweep tomorrow.
diego: thanks. ping if you need GPU/time. :rocket:
